title: SDGs Monitored by Borneo Tracker
content: Borneo Tracker currently represents these repository-supported SDGs: SDG1 - No Poverty; SDG2 - Zero Hunger; SDG3 - Good Health; SDG4 - Quality Education; SDG6 - Clean Water; SDG7 - Clean Energy; SDG8 - Economic Growth; SDG9 - Industry & Innovation; SDG11 - Sustainable Cities; SDG13 - Climate Action; SDG15 - Life on Land; SDG16 - Peace & Justice. This is the supported repository list, not a claim that all 17 UN SDGs are covered.
